## Scope review

- [ ] No Chrome permissions were added, or the change explains why one is required.
- [ ] No cloud inference, analytics, account, content-script, or broad webpage access was added.
- [ ] No prompts, responses, API keys, machine paths, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Persistence, streaming, Stop, and endpoint-policy behavior were considered.
